cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Agree to the Exact Words
cards.instruction: Agree to the exact wording, then use later callbacks to narrow what those words can obligate you to do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I agreed to watch your dog today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow's only a few hours away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Exactly. A separate word with no place in our agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An enduring feeling, not a calendar extension.
